Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, Rogers may terminate this Agreement, at any time, upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice to Licensor.
findings.explanation: Rogers has the unilateral right to terminate the contract at any time without cause upon 60 days notice, while Licensor lacks a corresponding right, leaving Licensor vulnerable after committing resources.
findings.suggested_change: Provide both parties with a mutual right to terminate for convenience upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice.

findings.quoted_text: In the event that Retail Revenues in a particular month are not sufficient to fully reimburse Rogers for the Rogers Costs incurred in such month, Rogers shall be entitled to recover such amounts against Retail Revenues generated by other Licensed Programs in subsequent months.
findings.explanation: Rogers can carry over unrecovered operational costs to future months and deduct them from future revenues, reducing my earnings for deficits I did not cause.
findings.suggested_change: Limit Rogers' cost recovery strictly to the revenues of the current month and program, prohibiting the carryover of negative balances to future months.

findings.quoted_text: Except with respect to any claim or liability arising from an infringement of any third party intellectual property right, in no event shall either party be liable for any special, indirect, consequential, punitive or incidental damages of any kind.
findings.explanation: By carving out third-party intellectual property claims from the waiver of consequential damages, my liability for IP claims is completely uncapped and could expose me to disproportionate indirect financial losses.
findings.suggested_change: Remove the intellectual property infringement carve-out from the waiver of indirect damages or cap total liability under the agreement.

findings.quoted_text: Licensor shall be responsible for any and all reasonable costs and/or losses incurred by Rogers as a result of any deletions from such list during the Term;
findings.explanation: I am held financially liable for any costs or losses Rogers incurs if I delete programs from the distribution list, even if necessary due to third-party rights expirations.
findings.suggested_change: Limit liability for program deletions to pre-approved direct costs and exempt deletions caused by rights expirations or circumstances beyond Licensor's control.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I am writing to propose a few minor adjustments to the agreement before we proceed. - Regarding the termination provision, the relevant clause allows one party to terminate at any time without cause, and I propose providing both parties with a mutual right to terminate for convenience upon sixty days prior written notice. - Regarding the cost recovery provision, unrecovered costs can be carried over to future periods, and I propose limiting cost recovery strictly to the revenues of the current period and program, prohibiting the carryover of negative balances to future months. - Regarding the liability provision, certain claims are carved out from the waiver of indirect damages, and I propose removing the intellectual property infringement carve-out from the waiver of indirect damages or capping total liability under the agreement. Thank you for your time and understanding.
